lines.en: Drooping fins sweep past the mangrove roots.
The water's murky; whiskers find the way.
In the swamp we travel only in pairs.
Slow going; these fins are too heavy.

lines.zh: 树干下的水道又窄又浅。
lines.en: The channel under the trunks is narrow and shallow.
Brown water grows brown scales.

lines.zh: 一只在前，一只贴着尾巴。
lines.en: One leads, one hugs the tail.
Fallen leaves cover half the creek bed.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我们往深处挪。
lines.en: The tide dropped; we shift deeper.
The fins drag through silt, leaving a trail.
These roots are denser than stone.
Mind the breathing roots hanging down.

lines.zh: 权重三十，这片沼泽归我们。
lines.en: Weight thirty; this swamp belongs to us.
Too bright up top; stay along the mud.

lines.zh: 水流推到根上，我钻过去。
lines.en: The current pushes me to the roots; I slip through.

lines.zh: 我摆两下尾，挪过半尺泥。
lines.en: Two flicks of my tail move me half a foot of mud.
Drooping fins resting on the mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽的午后，连水都不动。
lines.en: Swamp afternoon; even the water is still.
Neither of us says a word.

lines.zh: 气泡从泥里冒上来，一串。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the mud in a string.

lines.zh: 树叶落进水里，吓我一跳。
lines.en: A leaf fell in and startled me.
Bone meal settles slowly below us.
This pool is warm, like soup.

lines.zh: 我把须垂下去，听泥里动静。
lines.en: I lower my whiskers to hear the mud.
A dragonfly settled on the surface.

lines.zh: 红树的影子替我们挡光。
lines.en: Mangrove shade does our hiding.
Don't rush me; fish need to daydream.

lines.zh: 就我们两条，安静得刚好。
lines.en: Just the two of us; nicely quiet.

lines.zh: 沼泽的味道，一辈子闻不腻。
lines.en: That swamp smell never gets old.

lines.zh: 泥底软，鳍一沉就陷进去。
lines.en: The mud is soft; my fins sink in.
You stepped in the swamp; your feet sank.

lines.zh: 站在岸上看我们做什么。
lines.en: Standing on the bank, watching us?
Your trousers are covered in mud.
We're not fleeing, just lazy.
Your shadow disturbed the water surface.

lines.zh: 沼泽里少见这么高的人。
lines.en: Rare to see someone this tall here.
Put the net down; talk to us first.
Here for the fish, or the mangroves?

lines.zh: 水里看不清你，只看得见轮廓。
lines.en: Can't see you clearly, only your outline.

lines.zh: 我们的鳍垂着，不是生病。
lines.en: Our fins hang low; we're not sick.
It hurts; a roll in the mud helps.
My fin's bent; I can't swim fast.

lines.zh: 我们两条，总有一条能跑。
lines.en: Two of us; one can still escape.
Stop; this swamp is hard enough.
A few scales lost; they'll regrow.

lines.zh: 血混进泥水，看不出颜色。
lines.en: Blood in muddy water shows no color.

lines.zh: 我会把你的味道告诉伴侣。
lines.en: I'll tell my mate exactly how you smell.
The pain pulls my whiskers in.
We're poor fighters but hold grudges.
Dive into the roots; it's safe there.
Did a bug fall in the water?
Approach slowly; don't muddy the water.
Our whiskers taste it first.

lines.zh: 两条一起过来，谁也不抢。
lines.en: Both of us come, nobody grabs.
Fish food smells better than mud.
Shake your hand again and I'll come.
There isn't much to eat in this swamp.
Ground bone counts as a meal too.
We eat slowly; don't wander off.

lines.zh: 你手里那块，够我们俩分。
lines.en: That piece in your hand feeds both of us.
You stepped on my fin.

lines.zh: 泥扬起来，什么都看不见。
lines.en: Mud's up; I can't see anything.
The swamp is narrow; collisions happen.

lines.zh: 慢慢挪开，我的须缠住了。
lines.en: Move slowly; my whisker is tangled.

lines.zh: 你把一根红树根踩断了。
lines.en: You snapped a mangrove root.

lines.zh: 我们成双的队形被你撞散。
lines.en: You split our pair apart.

lines.zh: 水搅浑了，要等半天才清。
lines.en: Muddy water takes ages to clear.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，就是鳍打结了。
lines.en: Not a hard hit; just tangled fins.
Your boots are harder than stone.
Give us room; we swim slowly.
We build a bubble nest among the roots.
We're already a pair; nothing new.
Drooping fins overlapping make a promise.
Warm muddy water suits spawning.
The eggs will stick to root hairs.
The bubble nest isn't finished; don't stir it.
We don't need a big brood.
My mate's fins droop lower than mine.
The swamp raises the little ones.
By next season there'll be another pair.
No mangrove roots in this bucket.

lines.zh: 泥水换清水，浑身不对劲。
lines.en: Muddy water swapped for clear; I feel wrong.
Fins spread on the bucket floor; can't move.

lines.zh: 你会把我放进另一个沼泽吗。
lines.en: Will you put me in another swamp?
Don't forget we're a pair.

lines.zh: 晃一下，我就贴到桶壁上。
lines.en: One jolt and I'm against the wall.
The water outside is too bright.
Don't count on that bone meal.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥味，桶里一点没有。
lines.en: Not a trace of swamp mud in here.

lines.zh: 放我回去，红树根还在等我。
lines.en: Let me back; the roots are waiting.
Something heavy moves in the water.
The mud just got kicked up.
Only two of us; we must be careful.
That thing is far bigger than a fish.
Whiskers go up first, then we see.
A shadow behind the mangrove roots.
Swamp rule: hide first, ask later.
It steps hard enough to shake the mud.

lines.zh: 我们靠得近，互相挡一下。
lines.en: We stay close and cover each other.

lines.zh: 要是它先动手，我们就咬。
lines.en: If it strikes first, we bite.

lines.zh: 我们贴着根须，不急着冲。
lines.en: We hug the roots, in no hurry.
One move and the ripples give you away.
Two fish split left and right.

lines.zh: 这里的泥能藏下我们俩。
lines.en: The mud here can hide us both.
Drooping fins don't mean we're easy.
You wait; we wait too.
The swamp taught us patience.

lines.zh: 水面上的光在晃，你也晃。
lines.en: The surface light sways, and so do you.
Take one more step into the mud.
Make your choice; we're ready.
We bite and we don't let go.
The drooping fins whip like a lash.

lines.zh: 两条鱼一左一右夹过来。
lines.en: Two fish close in from both sides.

lines.zh: 泥搅起来，你什么都看不见。
lines.en: Mud swirls up; you see nothing.
Our teeth are small but many.
This bite is for the nest.
Your feet are stuck; you won't dodge.
Don't put your hand in; you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 打一下就退，回根须后头。
lines.en: Strike once, then back to the roots.
The swamp never lets prey go.

lines.zh: 红树根下多出两条小鳍。
lines.en: Two small fins appear under the roots.
The swamp water comes alive again.

lines.zh: 我们从泥里钻出，带着褐色。
lines.en: We rise from the mud, brown-finned.
Only one or two at a time.

lines.zh: 新鳍垂着，还没什么力气。
lines.en: New fins droop; no strength yet.

lines.zh: 这里权重三十，我们说了算。
lines.en: Weight thirty here; we run the place.

lines.zh: 潮水把我们带进了河汊。
lines.en: The tide carried us into the creek.
Our first mouthful tastes of mud.
The roots screen us from predators.

lines.zh: 沼泽又多了两条慢性子。
lines.en: The swamp gained two more slowpokes.
Can a swamp burn too?

lines.zh: 从岸上摔进水里，鳍拍散了。
lines.en: Dropped from the bank, my fins splayed.
We live in water, remember?
The whole creek flipped upside down.
The arrow clipped my fin's tip.
Purple light floats on the water.
Even swamps have hungry seasons.

lines.zh: 雷打在红树上，全滩发亮。
lines.en: Lightning struck a mangrove; the shallows lit up.
Even the mud and roots are gone.
